identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime][bug] Make agent-to-agent initiation first-class in live Observatory

values.task_boundary: Issue completion is exactly the first-class live-style agent-to-agent initiation bridge and proof; broader autonomy, broadcast, recursive messaging, and live production mutation are out of scope.
deliverables: First-class A2A action/bridge from model-backed Shepherd or resident-agent behavior into Runtime-governed initiation
Observatory/UI rendering or control path that distinguishes operator chat from A2A initiation and terminal recipient response
Focused deterministic tests proving live-style Beacon-to-Ember initiation
Regression coverage preserving the #662 kernel primitive semantics
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Beacon can request/contact Ember through a governed A2A action path instead of replying that it has no colleague when policy allows it
AC-2: The initiated work records distinct sender, recipient, work, conversation, turn, and correlation identity
AC-3: Recipient execution uses configured provider/model routing and the response returns to the initiating context without confusion with Beacon's own reply
AC-4: Missing recipient, unauthorized sender, unavailable authority/signing, stale recipient, cancellation, replay, and provider failure remain truthful terminal outcomes
AC-5: Observatory Activity/UI exposes accepted dispatch and terminal A2A result without inventing delivery truth
AC-6: Existing #662 direct primitive tests continue to pass
dependencies: No live Runtime/provider/AWS execution unless separately authorized
non_goals: Paid provider or AWS proof without explicit authorization
